guide.summary: Roman and medieval landmarks, churches, house museums, a garden and a funicular, with breakfast cafés, bakeries, trattorias, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Palazzo Maffei Casa Museo closes on Tuesdays and the Museo Miniscalchi-Erizzo opens only Friday to Monday, so save midweek for the churches, which open daily.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Palazzo Maffei Casa Museo closes on Tuesdays and the Museo Miniscalchi-Erizzo closes Tuesday to Thursday. Il Desco and Casa Perbellini close on Sundays and Mondays, and Pescheria I Masenini closes Sunday evening and all day Monday.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Fondazione Chiese Vive four-church route covers San Zeno, the Duomo, Santa Anastasia and San Fermo for €8 and stays valid for 90 days; a single church costs €4. Palazzo Maffei sells tickets online and at its box office.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Trattoria Al Pompiere confirms email bookings made at least 24 hours ahead and takes shorter-notice bookings by phone only. Ristorante Maffei says booking is always recommended but not required, and the churches need no reservation.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: At the Arena di Verona, bags over 17 litres, glass and outside food are not allowed, and smart casual dress is requested. Children under 14 must be with an adult, and children under 4 may sit only in the Family sector.

guide.dek: Plan museum days around Tuesday closures and book Verona's trattorias a day ahead, especially early in the week.
intro: Verona's headline sights are easy to plan once you know their weekly rhythms. The Arena di Verona stands on Piazza Bra, and Fondazione Arena di Verona has already published its next Opera Festival, running from 11 June to 11 September 2027. Its spectator rules ask you to arrive at least an hour before curtain, leave bags over 17 litres behind and wear smart casual dress. Close by, Torre dei Lamberti on Via della Costa opens every day except 25 December, and you can climb its 289 steps or take the glass lift.

Four historic churches run by Fondazione Chiese Vive share one ticketing system: the Basilica di San Zeno, the Complesso della Cattedrale (Duomo), the Basilica di Santa Anastasia and the Chiesa di San Fermo. From 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 they open on weekdays from 10:00 to 17:00, and Sunday visits start at 13:00 or 13:30. A single church costs €4, while the four-church route costs €8 and stays valid for 90 days. You don't need to book, but note that San Fermo has steep steps and no wheelchair access.

For smaller collections, Palazzo Maffei Casa Museo on Piazza Erbe opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00 except Tuesdays, with guided tours on Saturdays and Sundays at 10:30, 11:30 and 15:30. The Museo Miniscalchi-Erizzo on Via San Mammaso opens only Friday to Monday, charges €8 and lets children up to 11 in free. Giardino Giusti is open all year except 25 December, from 10:00 to 18:00 in winter, and the funicular on Via Fontanelle Santo Stefano climbs toward Castel San Pietro every day from 10:00, closing at 17:00 in winter.

Many restaurants close early in the week, so check before you plan dinner. Il Desco on Via Dietro San Sebastiano closes on Sundays and Mondays, Casa Perbellini also closes Saturday evenings, and Trattoria Al Bersagliere lists hours only from Tuesday to Saturday. Trattoria Al Pompiere takes email bookings at least 24 hours ahead and phone bookings for anything sooner. Ristorante Maffei on Piazza Erbe serves from 12:00 to 22:30 daily. For drinks, Romeo Cocktail Bar's cocktail bar opens at 19:00, and Terrazza Bar al Ponte by Ponte Pietra stays open from 09:00 to 02:00.
summaryCards: See the Arena di Verona on Piazza Bra, climb Torre dei Lamberti, then use the €8 four-church route for San Zeno, the Duomo, Santa Anastasia and San Fermo.
Start with a savory breakfast at Caffè Coloniale, then walk Giardino Giusti, open all year except 25 December.
Check closing days, since Il Desco and Casa Perbellini close on Sundays and Mondays and Trattoria Al Pompiere wants email bookings at least 24 hours ahead.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The civic-museum site (museicivici.comune.verona.it) refused connection, so Castelvecchio, Casa di Giulietta and the Teatro Romano could not be checked; Rivamancina had a certificate error, Trattoria Tre Marchetti returned 403, and Garage Coffee Bros and Gli Ormesini returned 429. Hours were not published on the pages read for Torre dei Lamberti, Antica Bottega del Vino, Trattoria Al Pompiere, Locanda 4 Cuochi and Flego; several places (Giardino Giusti, Romeo Cocktail Bar, Terrazza Bar al Ponte, Caffè Coloniale, De Rossi) show hours without a date, and the funicular and Giardino Giusti do not give season change dates. The Arena box-office hours differ slightly between two Fondazione Arena pages.
